entries.summaryZh: 1950年8月5日至20日，釜山防御圈战役期间，朝鲜人民军五个师在大邱周边试图强渡洛东江攻占该城，与美军第1骑兵师和韩军第二军团激战。美军防区内的渡江攻击被击退，韩军防区则一度失利，人民军还突袭303高地并俘虏美军。大邱最终未被攻占，是釜山防御圈的关键支撑点。
entries.summaryEn: From 5 to 20 August 1950, during the Battle of the Pusan Perimeter, five North Korean divisions massed around Taegu and tried to cross the Naktong River to take the city, fighting the US 1st Cavalry Division and ROK II Corps. Attacks in the American sector were repulsed while the ROK sector fared worse; Taegu held and anchored the perimeter.
entries.significanceZh: 太古之战守住了釜山防御圈的核心城市，为联合国军随后反攻争取了时间。
entries.significanceEn: Taegu held the core of the Pusan Perimeter and bought the United Nations Command time for the later counter-offensive.

entries.summaryZh: 1972年7月19日，佐法尔叛乱期间，解放被占领阿拉伯湾人民阵线的游击队在阿曼米尔巴特镇进攻政府军阵地。英国以特别空勤团人员协助阿曼政府训练与作战，守军在顽强抵抗后得到阿曼空军攻击机支援，游击队被迫撤退。此役是英国在佐法尔战争中直接介入的少数交战之一。
entries.summaryEn: On 19 July 1972, during the Dhofar Rebellion, PFLOAG guerrillas attacked the Omani government position at Mirbat. British SAS personnel assisting Oman's government took part in the defence, which held until Omani Strikemaster aircraft arrived and forced the guerrillas to retreat; it was one of the few actions of the war in which the British fought directly.
entries.significanceZh: 米尔巴特之战是佐法尔叛乱中的转折性防御战，保住了政府在佐法尔西部的据点。
entries.significanceEn: Mirbat was a turning-point defence in the Dhofar Rebellion that preserved the government's foothold in western Dhofar.

entries.summaryZh: 1982年6月8日，马岛战争期间，阿根廷空军的A-4天鹰攻击机在菲茨罗伊附近的普莱森特港轰炸正在向布拉夫湾输送部队的英国运输舰，造成56名英军死亡、150余人受伤。这是英军在整场战争中最惨重的单日损失之一，也促使英军调整两栖运输与防空部署。
entries.summaryEn: On 8 June 1982, during the Falklands War, Argentine Air Force Skyhawks bombed British troop transports at Port Pleasant off Fitzroy while they were landing troops at Bluff Cove, killing 56 British servicemen and wounding more than 150. It was among the heaviest single days of British losses in the war and forced changes in amphibious transport and air defence.
entries.significanceZh: 布拉夫湾空袭是马岛战争中英军最惨重的单日损失之一，暴露了登陆部队海上运输的脆弱性。
entries.significanceEn: The Bluff Cove air attacks were among the worst single days of British losses in the Falklands and exposed the vulnerability of amphibious movement.

entries.summaryZh: 2008年7月13日，约200名塔利班武装分子袭击阿富汗努里斯坦省瓦纳特村附近的美军偏远据点，包围并攻入基地，美军以炮兵与空中支援才将其击退。美军9人阵亡、27人受伤，成为阿富汗战争中美军伤亡最重的战斗之一。事后调查认为部分伤亡本可避免，多名军官受到处分。
entries.summaryEn: On 13 July 2008 about 200 Taliban fighters attacked an isolated American outpost near Wanat in Nuristan, Afghanistan, encircling it and breaking into the base before artillery and air support drove them off. Nine American soldiers were killed and 27 wounded, one of the bloodiest attacks on US forces in the war, and an official inquiry found some losses avoidable.
entries.significanceZh: 瓦纳特之战是阿富汗战争中美军最惨重的战斗之一，其调查结论推动了前线据点的重新评估。
entries.significanceEn: Wanat was among the bloodiest attacks on US forces in Afghanistan and its inquiry forced a rethink of remote outposts.

entries.summaryZh: 1900年11月7日，第二次布尔战争期间，英加联军在贝尔法斯特以南的科马蒂河畔列里方丹（又称维特克洛夫）与布尔军队交战。加拿大后卫部队击退布尔人的多次冲锋，掩护主力安全撤离。皇家加拿大龙骑兵三人因此获维多利亚十字勋章，此役成为加拿大军事史上的著名战例。
entries.summaryEn: On 7 November 1900, during the Second Boer War, British and Canadian forces fought the Boers at Leliefontein, also known as Witkloof, on the Komati River south of Belfast. The Canadian rearguard repelled repeated Boer charges and covered the column's withdrawal; three members of the Royal Canadian Dragoons received the Victoria Cross.
entries.significanceZh: 列里方丹之战是加拿大军事史上最著名的后卫战之一，三人因此获维多利亚十字勋章。
entries.significanceEn: Leliefontein is one of the best-known rearguard actions in Canadian military history, with three Victoria Crosses awarded.

entries.summaryZh: 1927年7月，美国占领尼加拉瓜期间，桑地诺率领的叛乱武装进攻新塞戈维亚省奥科塔尔，镇内仅有少量美国海军陆战队员与尼加拉瓜国民警卫队驻守。叛乱者被击退并遭受重大伤亡，守方损失轻微。此役是桑地诺起义初期的重要战斗，也是美国空中力量介入拉美的早期案例之一。
entries.summaryEn: In July 1927, during the United States occupation of Nicaragua, rebels loyal to Augusto Cesar Sandino attacked Ocotal in Nueva Segovia, held by a small force of US Marines and Nicaraguan National Guards. The attackers were driven off with heavy losses while the defenders suffered few casualties; it was an early engagement of Sandino's rebellion.
entries.significanceZh: 奥科塔尔之战是桑地诺起义初期的关键交战，也是美国空中力量介入拉美冲突的早期案例。
entries.significanceEn: Ocotal was a key early engagement of Sandino's rebellion and an early case of American air power in Latin American conflict.

entries.summaryZh: 1982年6月13日夜至14日，马岛战争期间，英军第2伞兵营在轻型坦克与炮兵支援下进攻斯坦利港以西的无线岭，与阿根廷第7步兵团等部激战。英军当夜攻占该岭，阿根廷守军溃退，次日岛上全部阿军投降，马岛战争的主要战斗就此结束。
entries.summaryEn: On the night of 13 to 14 June 1982, during the Falklands War, the British 2nd Battalion, the Parachute Regiment, with light tanks and artillery support, attacked Wireless Ridge west of Port Stanley against the Argentine 7th Infantry Regiment. The ridge was taken that night and the whole Argentine force on the islands surrendered the following day.
entries.significanceZh: 无线岭之战是马岛战争最后一场主要地面战，其胜利直接促成阿根廷守军次日投降。
entries.significanceEn: Wireless Ridge was the last major ground battle of the Falklands War and its capture led directly to the Argentine surrender.

entries.summaryZh: 1494年11月14日至15日，卡斯蒂利亚军队在阿隆索·费尔南德斯·德·卢戈率领下于特内里费岛的阿圭雷平原击败关契斯人，报了此前阿森特霍首战失利之仇。此次胜利使卡斯蒂利亚重新掌握对特内里费的攻势，一个多月后的第二次阿森特霍之战最终完成了对该岛的征服。
entries.summaryEn: On 14 and 15 November 1494 Castilian forces under Alonso Fernandez de Lugo defeated the Guanches on the plain of Aguere in Tenerife, avenging their earlier defeat at the First Battle of Acentejo. The victory restored the Castilian offensive on the island, and the Second Battle of Acentejo a month later completed the conquest of Tenerife.
entries.significanceZh: 阿圭雷之战扭转了卡斯蒂利亚征服特内里费的战局，为最终占领该岛铺平道路。
entries.significanceEn: Aguere reversed the Castilian campaign in Tenerife and paved the way for the island's conquest.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年4月16日至19日，第二次世界大战欧洲战场最后阶段，苏军三个方面军在奥德河-尼萨河一线发起突破，这是柏林战役的开局阶段，德方称之为奥德河-尼萨河战役。苏军在四天内突破德军防线，随后向柏林推进，此役是红军在中欧攻势中的关键一步。
entries.summaryEn: From 16 to 19 April 1945, in the last phase of the Second World War in Europe, three Soviet fronts broke through the German defences on the Oder and Neisse rivers in the opening phase of the Battle of Berlin, known in German as the Battle of the Oder-Neisse. The breakthrough opened the Soviet advance on Berlin.
entries.significanceZh: 奥德河-尼萨河战役是柏林战役的开局突破，苏军由此打开了通往柏林的道路。
entries.significanceEn: The Oder-Neisse battle was the opening breakthrough of the Battle of Berlin and opened the Soviet road to the city.

entries.summaryZh: 1828年8月21日，即俄历8月9日，俄土战争期间，帕斯克维奇元帅率约九千俄军在阿哈尔齐赫城下进攻基奥斯-马霍梅特帕夏指挥的三万土耳其军队。俄军借雷暴掩护突袭取胜，随后经一周围攻攻占阿哈尔齐赫城堡。此役为俄军在高加索战场的推进打开了门户。
entries.summaryEn: On 21 August 1828, 9 August on the old calendar, during the Russo-Turkish War, Field Marshal Paskevich led some 9,000 Russians against 30,000 Turks under Kios-Mahomet-Pasha beneath the walls of Akhaltsikhe. A surprise attack in a heavy thunderstorm won the day, and the Russians stormed the fortress a week later, opening the Caucasus to their advance.
entries.significanceZh: 阿哈尔齐赫之战为俄军在高加索战场的推进打开门户，是1828至1829年俄土战争的关键胜利。
entries.significanceEn: Akhaltsikhe opened the Caucasus to the Russian advance and was a key victory of the Russo-Turkish War of 1828-1829.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年5月7日，波兰东南部库里沃夫卡村附近，反共抵抗组织民族军事联盟与苏联内务人民委员部部队交战。波兰地下武装击败了苏军部队，是战后波兰反共抵抗中少数取得胜利的交战之一。此役发生在德国投降前夕，显示战后波兰地下武装与苏联当局的冲突已经开始。
entries.summaryEn: On 7 May 1945, near the village of Kurykowka in south-eastern Poland, the anti-communist National Military Alliance fought NKVD units. The Polish underground force won the engagement, one of the few victories of the post-war anti-communist resistance, and the fighting on the eve of Germany's surrender showed that conflict with the Soviet authorities had already begun.
entries.significanceZh: 库里沃夫卡之战是战后波兰反共抵抗的早期胜利，预示了此后数年的地下武装斗争。
entries.significanceEn: Kurykowka was an early victory of the post-war Polish anti-communist resistance and prefigured years of underground fighting.

entries.summaryZh: 1948年5月19日至24日，第一次中东战争期间，埃及军队多次进攻以色列的亚德莫迪凯基布兹。居民与二十名哈加纳战士坚守数日，最终在埃军攻入部分区域后撤离，基布兹于5月24日陷落。这场拖延战为以色列争取了五天时间，使其得以在阿德哈洛姆一线挡住埃军北上。
entries.summaryEn: From 19 to 24 May 1948, during the 1948 Arab-Israeli War, Egyptian forces attacked the Israeli kibbutz of Yad Mordechai repeatedly. The residents and twenty Haganah fighters held out for days before withdrawing as the Egyptians took part of the settlement, which fell on 24 May; the delay let Israeli forces halt the Egyptian advance at Ad Halom.
entries.significanceZh: 亚德莫迪凯之战以五天迟滞换取了以军的部署时间，随后以军在阿德哈洛姆挡住了埃军北进。
entries.significanceEn: Yad Mordechai bought five days for Israeli deployment and was followed by the successful blocking of the Egyptian advance at Ad Halom.

entries.summaryZh: 2009年9月8日，阿富汗战争期间，美军与阿富汗国民军在库纳尔省甘加尔村附近遭塔利班伏击。联军多次请求火力支援未果，战斗中美军与阿军伤亡惨重。事后调查认为指挥链未能及时提供支援，多名军官受到处分；两名参加战斗的军人后来获颁荣誉勋章。
entries.summaryEn: On 8 September 2009, during the war in Afghanistan, American and Afghan forces were ambushed by the Taliban near Ganjgal in Kunar Province. Requests for fire support went unanswered and the coalition units suffered heavy losses; an official investigation led to reprimands and two participants later received the Medal of Honor.
entries.significanceZh: 甘加尔之战暴露了联军指挥链的支援失灵，其调查与授勋结果推动了战术与指挥问责的调整。
entries.significanceEn: Ganjgal exposed a failure of the coalition chain of command, and the inquiry and medals that followed pushed changes in fire support and accountability.
